crossRefs.note: Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
Yahweh is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.
You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but Yahweh helped me.
Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you…
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help…
“Behold, my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul delights: I have put my Spirit on him. He will bring…
For the Lord Yahweh will help me. Therefore I have not been confounded. Therefore I have set my face like a flint, and…
What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”

translations.web: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.
translations.bsb: Surely God is my helper; the Lord is the sustainer of my soul.
translations.kjv: Behold, God is mine helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.
translations.asv: Behold, God is my helper: The Lord is of them that uphold my soul.
